packages.name: ZoneAODFix
packages.description: Keeps Zone's animated Sleep stage visible during Always-On Display instead of letting progress updates restore the Locked wallpaper.
packages.tested: Tested on iPhone 14 Pro · iOS 16.1 · Dopamine

changes: Consolidated Zone transition handling without changing the confirmed AOD fix.
Removed diagnostic-only parser hooks and reduced runtime logging.
Improved safe hook installation and retry handling.
Prevented Zone progress scrubbing from overwriting the Sleep wallpaper during AOD.
Restored the Locked transition when the display wakes.
